name: @metorial/vonage
description: Send messages across SMS, MMS, WhatsApp, Messenger, Viber and RCS. Create and control phone calls with NCCO or an answer URL, read call records, start and check verifications, inspect Number Insight results, manage virtual numbers and applications, and read balance or manage subaccounts and account transfers. Product provisioning, regional restrictions and charges apply; accepted requests do not prove delivery. Number Insight is scheduled to sunset February 4, 2027.
